ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surfaces.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the distal-lateral sections of both lobes; solid dark pigmentation is concentrated at the central peduncle insertion and along the leading edges, with mottled speckling transitioning between color zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an internal pixel angle of approximately 50 degrees; notch depth is roughly 1/6th of the vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated trailing edge with varying pixel amplitude; the right lobe tip exhibits significant irregular protrusion due to high-contrast clusters.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep trajectory measured from the median notch extending distally toward both lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly visible high-contrast white circular clusters (barnacle colonies) localized on the distal tips of both lobes, with a major concentration on the far right tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint dark vertical linear marks are visible on the white sections of the right lobe; sparse horizontal linear disruptions are detected on the left lobe's white area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant structural irregularity on the right lobe tip caused by a dense colony of barnacles; several dark focal scars are scattered within the white pigmentation zones of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique dense speckling pattern at the color transition zones and a small, distinct dark circular spot located near the upper-distal edge of the left lobe's white patch.
